name: Máel Fothartaig
text: Máel Fothartaig is a hero of Leinster. His own father brings about his death in the tale Fingal Rónán, known in English as How Rónán Slew His Son.

attributes.attribute: Leinster hero slain by his own father
victim of the tale Fingal Rónán

okr.objective: Documents Máel Fothartaig as recorded in MacKillop 2008 for the Public Celtic Encyclopedia.
key_results: Máel Fothartaig is a Leinster hero.
